/parties/{partyId}/contact-points:
    get:
      summary: Read the contact points of a party
      description: Contact points of a party with the consent and verification state of each channel, and the stop mark of the case the caller names. Case reference parameter schema Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-6724)
      x-module: P6
      x-owner: "P6"
      x-capability:
        area: Documents
        right: R
      parameters:
      - name: partyId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success, list of ContactPoint
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E401'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E403'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E404'
        '503':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E503'
  /contact-points/{contactKey}:
    put:
      summary: Maintain the consent and verification state of one contact point and channel
      description: Returns the stored ContactPoint and its new version. Request fields (channel code, consent and verification values) Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-6725). A repeat with the same If-Match version returns the first answer.
      x-module: P6
      x-owner: "P6"
      x-capability:
        area: Documents
        right: U
      parameters:
      - name: contactKey
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: If-Match
        in: header
        required: true
        description: Version of the contact point as read
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              description: ContactPointRequest, fields Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-6725)
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success, stored ContactPoint with its new version
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E401'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E403'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E404'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E409'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E422'
        '503':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/E503'
